message: Review of fix/ledger-fetch-isolation (070c456): CHANGES REQUESTED. The added --refmap= and --no-write-fetch-head on all three fetches are correct; 16-way concurrent fetch test passes and preserves refs/remotes/origin/jarvis-orchestration and FETCH_HEAD. Remaining medium-priority race: Client/Modules/LedgerStore.fs:427-441 reads shared refs/jarvis/ledger-cache/<projectId>, verifies ancestry, then blindly update-ref's the cache. If fetch A retrieves X and fetch B retrieves newer descendant Y, B can write Y before A overwrites cache with X. Fix with expected-old-OID git update-ref CAS, retry/reconcile if concurrent fetch advanced; add a regression with different fetched remote heads. Full client Release: 361 pass, 1 unrelated timeout in startJob strips sensitive inherited environment (also fails isolated). No changes/merge made by reviewer.
